night_start: Night falls on the village. Everyone, close your eyes.
mafia_wake: Mafia, open your eyes. Choose the person you want to eliminate, and tap their name.
doctor_wake: Doctor, open your eyes. Choose one person to save tonight, and tap their name.
detective_wake: Detective, open your eyes. Choose one person to investigate, and tap their name.
morning: The sun rises. Everyone, open your eyes.
killed: Last night, the Mafia struck. Someone did not survive. Look at the screen.
saved: Last night, the Mafia struck, but the Doctor saved their target. No one died.
discuss: Discuss among yourselves, and find the Mafia.
vote: It is time to vote. Who will be eliminated?
voted_out: The village has spoken. Look at the screen.
tie: The vote is tied. No one is eliminated today.
villagers_win: All the Mafia have been found. The villagers win!
mafia_win: The Mafia now control the village. The Mafia win!
pass_hint: Place the phone in the middle where everyone can reach it.
detective_found: The Detective found one of the Mafia last night.
